passages.title: 지점 통합 고객 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Meridian Bank
To: Business Account Holders, Elm Street Branch
Subject: Your Branch Is Merging with Center Plaza

Dear Customer,

On August 15, the Elm Street branch will merge with our Center Plaza location, 800 meters away. Your account numbers, cards, and online banking remain unchanged — no action is required.

Center Plaza offers longer hours (weekdays to 6 p.m., Saturdays to 1 p.m.), six teller windows, and a dedicated business banking desk with two advisors. Safe deposit box holders at Elm Street will receive a separate letter about transferring boxes, with appointments available through September.

The Elm Street ATM lobby stays open around the clock even after the merger. To welcome you, business customers visiting Center Plaza before September 30 can meet an advisor without an appointment and receive a free account review.

Meridian Bank Customer Service

questions.q: What must customers do about their accounts?
questions.exKo: 계좌번호·카드·온라인뱅킹 모두 그대로라 조치가 필요 없습니다.
why: 'no action is required'가 그대로 정답
카드는 그대로 쓸 수 있으므로 반대
온라인뱅킹도 변경 없어 재등록 불필요
8월 15일 전 방문 요구 언급 없음
questions.ev: Your account numbers, cards, and online banking remain unchanged — no action is required.

questions.q: Who will receive a separate letter?
questions.exKo: 대여금고 이용 고객에게는 이관 안내문이 별도 발송됩니다.
why: 대여금고 고객에게 별도 안내문을 보낸다고 명시
이 메일 자체가 이미 사업자 고객 전체 대상
상담역은 안내문 수신 대상이 아님
ATM 이용자 대상 별도 안내 언급 없음
questions.ev: Safe deposit box holders at Elm Street will receive a separate letter about transferring boxes

questions.q: What stays open after the merger?
questions.exKo: Elm Street의 ATM 로비는 통합 후에도 24시간 운영됩니다.
why: 'stays open around the clock'이 그대로 정답
창구 6개는 Center Plaza 시설, 문맥이 다름
기업금융 데스크도 Center Plaza 쪽 시설
지점 자체는 통합되어 문을 닫으므로 반대
questions.ev: The Elm Street ATM lobby stays open around the clock even after the merger.

passages.title: 공동 마케팅 제휴 제안 메일
passages.passage:
From: Partnerships, TrailKit Outdoor Gear
To: Marketing Team, Summit Coffee Roasters
Subject: Partnership Proposal — Campers Love Coffee

Hello Summit team,

Our customer survey found that 71 percent of TrailKit buyers brew coffee outdoors, and your brand came up repeatedly as a favorite. We would like to propose a three-month partnership for the spring camping season.

The idea: a co-branded 'Sunrise Kit' — our folding stove bundled with your travel-size beans — sold on both our web stores, with profits split by contribution cost. Each brand promotes the kit to its own audience; we reach 200,000 newsletter readers, and we understand your social following is similarly engaged.

Neither side pays the other; we both gain access to a matched audience. If the kit sells 3,000 units, we would discuss a year-round line. Could we set up a call next week? I have attached mockups and a draft cost split.

Jordan Avery, Partnerships Lead

questions.q: What is proposed?
questions.exKo: 스토브와 원두를 묶은 공동 브랜드 키트 판매 제휴 제안입니다.
why: 스토브와 원두를 묶은 공동 브랜드 상품 제안
두 회사의 합병이나 인수 언급 없음
서로 비용을 내지 않으므로 광고 구매가 아님
납품 계약이 아니라 공동 판매 제휴
questions.ev: The idea: a co-branded 'Sunrise Kit' — our folding stove bundled with your travel-size beans — sold on both our web stores

questions.q: How would profits be divided?
questions.exKo: 각 사의 기여 원가에 따라 이익을 나눕니다.
why: 'split by contribution cost'가 그대로 정답
지문에 균등 배분 언급 없음
지문에 판매 채널 기준 언급 없음
TrailKit이 더 가져간다는 언급 없음
questions.ev: with profits split by contribution cost

questions.q: What would trigger discussing a year-round line?
questions.exKo: 키트가 3,000개 팔리면 상시 라인업 논의를 시작합니다.
why: 3,000개 판매가 상시 라인업 논의의 조건
통화는 제휴 논의를 위한 첫 단계일 뿐
뉴스레터 20만 명은 현재 도달 규모
지문에 신형 스토브 언급 없음
questions.ev: If the kit sells 3,000 units, we would discuss a year-round line.

passages.title: 임직원 주식 매수 프로그램 공지
passages.passage:
EMPLOYEE SHARE PURCHASE PLAN — ENROLLMENT WINDOW

Enrollment for the next six-month cycle of the share purchase plan opens Monday and closes on the 15th. Through the plan, you may set aside 1 to 10 percent of salary, and shares are purchased at a 15 percent discount to the lower of the cycle's starting or ending market price.

Contributions are deducted after tax each pay period and held until the purchase date at cycle end. You may reduce your rate or withdraw entirely once per cycle; withdrawn contributions are returned in full with the next payroll.

Shares must be held at least one year before selling, a period during which dividends are paid normally. Enrollment continues automatically between cycles unless you change it. The plan guide, tax notes for each country, and a savings calculator are on the benefits portal.

Total participation reached 64 percent of eligible staff last cycle, the highest to date.

Benefits Administration

questions.q: How is the purchase price set?
choices: 15 percent below the lower of start or end price
questions.exKo: 기간 시작가와 종료가 중 낮은 쪽에서 15% 할인된 가격입니다.
why: 시작가와 종료가 중 낮은 값에서 15% 할인
지문에 평균가 기준 언급 없음
지문에 종가 기준 언급 없음
지문에 이사회 결정 언급 없음
questions.ev: shares are purchased at a 15 percent discount to the lower of the cycle's starting or ending market price

questions.q: What happens to withdrawn contributions?
choices: Returned in full with the next payroll
questions.exKo: 중도 철회 시 다음 급여일에 전액 반환됩니다.
why: 'returned in full with the next payroll'이 근거
주기 종료까지 보유하지 않고 바로 반환
주식 전환이 아니라 현금 반환
전액 반환이므로 일부 환불은 반대
questions.ev: withdrawn contributions are returned in full with the next payroll

questions.q: How long must purchased shares be held?
questions.exKo: 매수 후 최소 1년간 보유해야 매도할 수 있습니다.
why: 'held at least one year'가 그대로 정답
6개월은 납입 주기이지 보유 기간이 아님
퇴직 시까지 보유 언급 없음
최소 보유 기간이 있으므로 반대
questions.ev: Shares must be held at least one year before selling

passages.title: 협력업체 등록 갱신 절차 공지
passages.passage:
SUPPLIER REGISTRATION RENEWAL — ACTION REQUIRED

All suppliers must renew their registration in the procurement system by December 1 to remain eligible for orders next year. Renewal takes about 20 minutes if your documents are current.

Required uploads: business license, tax compliance certificate issued within 90 days, insurance certificate meeting the coverage levels in Annex B, and bank details on company letterhead. Suppliers of safety-related goods must additionally upload current product certifications.

New this year, the system checks document expiry dates automatically and emails reminders 30 days before anything lapses — no more surprise ineligibility. Suppliers who miss the December 1 deadline enter a re-approval queue that averages six weeks, during which no new purchase orders can be issued.

Questions go to supplier-desk@procurement portal, response within two business days.

Procurement Operations

questions.q: What is the consequence of missing the deadline?
choices: A six-week re-approval queue with no new orders
questions.exKo: 재승인 대기 약 6주 동안 신규 발주를 받을 수 없습니다.
why: 평균 6주 재승인 대기와 신규 발주 중단이 그대로 제시됨
벌금이나 과태료 부과는 지문에 전혀 언급 없음
재승인 절차로 복귀할 수 있으므로 영구 제명은 지문과 반대
6주간 발주가 막히므로 별일 아니라는 진술은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: Suppliers who miss the December 1 deadline enter a re-approval queue that averages six weeks, during which no new purchase orders can be issued.

questions.q: How recent must the tax certificate be?
questions.exKo: 90일 이내 발급된 납세증명서가 필요합니다.
why: 'issued within 90 days'가 발급 기한을 그대로 명시함
1년 이내라는 기간은 지문에 언급되지 않은 숫자
30일은 만료 알림 시점이지 발급 기한이 아님(숫자 반복 함정)
발급 시점 제한이 분명히 있으므로 지문과 반대
questions.ev: tax compliance certificate issued within 90 days

questions.q: What does the new system feature do?
questions.exKo: 만료 30일 전에 자동 알림 메일을 보내 줍니다.
why: 만료 30일 전 자동 알림 메일 발송이 올해 새 기능임
즉시 승인해 준다는 기능은 지문에 언급 없음
문서 번역 기능은 지문 어디에도 언급되지 않음
구매 발주 발행은 시스템 기능으로 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: the system checks document expiry dates automatically and emails reminders 30 days before anything lapses

passages.title: 탕비실 스낵 정기배송 광고
passages.passage:
SNACKLOOP — THE BREAK ROOM THAT RESTOCKS ITSELF

An empty snack shelf empties the room. SnackLoop delivers a curated mix of snacks, drinks, and coffee to your office weekly — and adjusts every delivery based on what your team actually eats.

Our smart shelf weighs stock levels and reorders automatically, so favorites never run out and slow movers rotate out. Choose themes like healthy, local, or international, and set a monthly budget the system never exceeds. Allergy-friendly items are labeled and stocked separately.

Plans from $149 a month for teams up to 20, with no delivery fees and free shelf hardware on annual plans. Companies report the snack corner becoming the new meeting spot — collaboration you can taste. Start a two-week free trial at snackloop.com.

questions.q: How does SnackLoop adjust deliveries?
choices: Based on what the team actually consumes
questions.exKo: 실제 소비 데이터를 바탕으로 매주 구성을 조정합니다.
why: 'actually eats'가 실제 소비량 기준임을 뜻함
계절에 따라 바꾼다는 기준은 지문에 언급 없음
직원 투표로 정한다는 방식은 지문에 언급 없음
데이터 기반 조정이므로 무작위라는 설명은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: adjusts every delivery based on what your team actually eats

questions.q: What does the smart shelf do?
questions.exKo: 재고 무게를 감지해 자동으로 재주문합니다.
why: 재고 무게를 감지해 자동 재주문한다고 그대로 서술됨
음료를 냉각하는 기능은 지문에 언급되지 않음
직원에게 요금을 부과한다는 내용은 언급 없음
광고를 표시한다는 기능은 지문에 언급 없음
questions.ev: Our smart shelf weighs stock levels and reorders automatically

questions.q: What is included with annual plans?
questions.exKo: 연간 플랜에는 스마트 선반 하드웨어가 무료 제공됩니다.
why: 'free shelf hardware'가 연간 플랜의 혜택임
간식을 추가로 더 준다는 언급은 지문에 없음
커피 머신 무료 제공은 지문에 언급되지 않음
주말 배송 서비스는 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: no delivery fees and free shelf hardware on annual plans

passages.title: 경영진 미디어 트레이닝 광고
passages.passage:
CAMERA-READY — MEDIA TRAINING FOR EXECUTIVES

One awkward interview clip can outlive years of good work. Camera-Ready prepares executives for press interviews, earnings calls, and crisis statements through realistic practice, not theory.

Our one-day intensive puts you in front of real cameras with former journalists asking the questions your industry actually faces — including the ones you hope nobody asks. Every answer is reviewed on playback with a coach, and you leave with personal techniques for bridging to your message under pressure.

Sessions are strictly confidential and limited to four participants. Available at our studio or your office; a half-day crisis simulation for leadership teams can be added. Executives from over 300 companies have trained with us. Enquire at cameraready.co — discretion guaranteed.

questions.q: What makes the training realistic?
choices: Real cameras and former journalists asking hard questions
questions.exKo: 실제 카메라 앞에서 전직 기자들이 곤란한 질문까지 던집니다.
why: 실제 카메라와 전직 기자의 곤란한 질문이 현실성의 근거
이론이 아닌 실전 연습이라 했으므로 지문과 반대
온라인 퀴즈로 학습한다는 내용은 언급 없음
뉴스 영상 시청 방식은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: puts you in front of real cameras with former journalists asking the questions your industry actually faces

questions.q: How are answers improved?
questions.exKo: 녹화를 다시 보며 코치와 함께 검토합니다.
why: 'reviewed on playback'이 녹화 검토를 뜻함
나중에 서면 피드백을 준다는 내용은 언급 없음
동료 투표로 평가한다는 방식은 언급 없음
독학용 자료 제공은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: Every answer is reviewed on playback with a coach

questions.q: What is stated about session size?
questions.exKo: 세션당 최대 4명으로 제한되어 기밀이 보장됩니다.
why: 'limited to four participants'가 인원 제한을 그대로 명시
4명으로 제한한다고 했으므로 무제한은 지문과 반대
1대1 전용이라는 형식은 지문에 언급되지 않음
300은 이용 기업 수이지 세션 인원이 아님(숫자 반복 함정)
questions.ev: Sessions are strictly confidential and limited to four participants.

passages.title: 사무지구 점심 구독 서비스 기사
passages.passage:
FINCH DISTRICT — Lunch subscription startup MidDay has signed up 6,000 office workers in the financial district within a year of launching. Members pay $99 monthly for ten lunch credits usable at 45 partner restaurants, ordering ahead through an app and skipping lines at dedicated pickup shelves.

Restaurants accept a lower margin per meal in exchange for predictable volume on slow weekdays; several report that Tuesday sales, once their weakest, now match Fridays. MidDay's data also helps partners plan: restaurants see demand forecasts three days ahead, cutting food waste by an average of 18 percent.

Rivals have noticed — two delivery platforms launched similar passes last quarter. MidDay's founder argues the pickup model wins in dense districts: "At lunch, a five-minute walk beats a thirty-minute wait for a courier." The company expands to two more districts in the fall.

questions.q: How does the MidDay service work?
choices: Monthly credits for pickup lunches at partner restaurants
questions.exKo: 월 구독 크레딧으로 제휴 식당에서 픽업하는 방식입니다.
why: 월 구독 크레딧으로 제휴 식당에서 픽업하는 구조임
배달원이 아닌 본인 픽업 방식이므로 지문과 반대
할인 카드가 아니라 크레딧 구독제이므로 성격이 다름
회사 구내식당 운영은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: Members pay $99 monthly for ten lunch credits usable at 45 partner restaurants, ordering ahead through an app and skipping lines at dedicated pickup shelves.

questions.q: Why do restaurants accept lower margins?
questions.exKo: 한산한 요일의 예측 가능한 물량을 얻기 때문입니다.
why: 'predictable volume'이 마진 양보의 대가임
무료 광고 제공은 지문에 언급되지 않은 혜택
다른 곳에서 값을 올린다는 내용은 언급 없음
메뉴를 줄인다는 내용은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: Restaurants accept a lower margin per meal in exchange for predictable volume on slow weekdays

questions.q: What advantage does the founder claim over delivery?
choices: A short walk beats waiting for a courier
questions.exKo: 밀집 지역에서는 5분 도보 픽업이 30분 배달 대기보다 낫다고 주장합니다.
why: 5분 도보가 30분 배달 대기보다 낫다는 창업자 주장 그대로
가격이 더 싸다는 비교는 지문에 언급되지 않음
음식 품질 우위에 대한 언급은 지문에 없음
양이 더 많다는 내용은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: At lunch, a five-minute walk beats a thirty-minute wait for a courier.

passages.title: 고령 직원 재고용 제도 확산 기사
passages.passage:
LABOR DESK — Facing shortages of experienced technicians, manufacturers are increasingly rehiring their own retirees on flexible contracts. A survey of 300 industrial firms found 44 percent now run formal 'returnship' programs, double the share of three years ago.

Typical arrangements involve two or three days a week, often centered on mentoring younger staff and handling complex maintenance that shorter-tenured workers have not yet mastered. Pay is prorated from the retiree's final salary, and most programs cap total hours to protect pension arrangements.

Firms report two main benefits: critical knowledge stays in the building, and training time for juniors shortens measurably — one engine plant credits retiree mentors with cutting certification time for new welders from 14 months to 9. Unions, initially wary, have largely supported the schemes since hours limits were standardized.

questions.q: What trend does the article describe?
questions.exKo: 숙련 인력 부족으로 퇴직자를 유연 계약으로 재고용하는 흐름입니다.
why: 숙련공 부족으로 퇴직자를 유연 계약 재고용한다는 첫 문장
조기 퇴직을 권한다는 내용은 지문과 정반대 방향
로봇으로 대체한다는 내용은 지문에 언급 없음
주 2~3일 근무이므로 근무 연장은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: Facing shortages of experienced technicians, manufacturers are increasingly rehiring their own retirees on flexible contracts.

questions.q: What do returning retirees typically do?
choices: Mentor younger staff and complex maintenance
questions.exKo: 주 2~3일 근무하며 멘토링과 고난도 정비를 맡습니다.
why: 후배 멘토링과 고난도 정비 담당이라고 그대로 명시
주 2~3일 근무이므로 전일 생산직은 지문과 반대
관리직을 맡는다는 내용은 지문에 언급 없음
영업 방문 업무는 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: often centered on mentoring younger staff and handling complex maintenance

questions.q: What result did the engine plant report?
choices: Welder certification time fell from 14 to 9 months
questions.exKo: 용접공 인증 기간이 14개월에서 9개월로 단축되었습니다.
why: 용접공 인증 기간이 14개월에서 9개월로 줄었다고 명시
생산량이 두 배가 되었다는 수치는 언급 없음
근무시간 상한이 있으므로 전일 근무는 지문과 반대
임금이 올랐다는 내용은 지문에 언급되지 않음
questions.ev: cutting certification time for new welders from 14 months to 9

passages.title: 웹사이트 접속 급증 대응 문자
passages.passage:
Tim Novak (8:55 P.M.)
Our brand just got mentioned on a national TV show. Site traffic is 20x normal and climbing.

Ada Osei (8:57 P.M.)
On it. Auto-scaling kicked in — pages are loading, but checkout is slowing. Response times tripled in the last five minutes.

Tim Novak (8:58 P.M.)
What's the bottleneck?

Ada Osei (9:00 P.M.)
The inventory check on each order. I can switch it to the cached count — tiny oversell risk on low-stock items, but checkout gets fast again.

Tim Novak (9:01 P.M.)
How many items are low-stock right now?

Ada Osei (9:02 P.M.)
Eleven products under 20 units. I can hide those from the storefront during the spike as a safety net.

Tim Novak (9:03 P.M.)
Do both. Better to hide eleven products than lose a thousand carts.

Ada Osei (9:05 P.M.)
Done. Checkout under a second again. I'll restore the low-stock items and normal checks once traffic settles.

passages.title: 해외 바이어 공장 견학 준비 문자
passages.passage:
Sofia Ricci (2:00 P.M.)
The Nagoya buyers confirmed for Thursday — four people, arriving 10 A.M., interpreter included on their side.

Dan Kovac (2:03 P.M.)
Great. Standard tour route, or the extended one with the R&D lab?

Sofia Ricci (2:05 P.M.)
Extended — they specifically asked about our coating process. Legal cleared the lab visit as long as photos are limited to the marked zones.

Dan Kovac (2:07 P.M.)
I'll brief the lab team and post the photo-zone signs in Japanese too. Lunch after?

Sofia Ricci (2:09 P.M.)
Yes, the private dining room. One guest is vegetarian — menu already adjusted. And they'd like the quality certificates in English before they leave.

Dan Kovac (2:11 P.M.)
I'll have printed copies plus a USB. Should we prepare unit pricing too?

Sofia Ricci (2:12 P.M.)
Not yet — this visit is technical evaluation only. Pricing comes if they shortlist us next month.

Dan Kovac (2:13 P.M.)
Understood. I'll send you the final schedule tonight.
